title: 艾希·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 雪白头发与蓝色兜帽披风相互映衬，晶体装饰透出冷亮细节。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ashe is an adult Freljordian archer with long white hair, clear blue eyes, a blue hooded cloak, and distinctive crystalline ornamentation. Preserve her focused human face and athletic adult proportions in a fully covering warm blue-and-ivory tunic, opaque leggings, gloves, and boots. Her large ice bow is held vertically beside her body with no arrow nocked and no aiming posture.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: frost blue, white hair, steel gray, pale gold light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
